text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines a language model with a retrieval system. The retrieval system finds relevant external passages, which are provided to the language model as additional context.
RAG can provide access to information that is not stored in the language model parameters. The quality of retrieved evidence can influence the quality of generated answers.
Dense retrieval represents queries and documents as numerical vectors. Similarity between these vectors can be used to rank candidate documents.
